newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Nine stocks rose, four fell and six were flat in 10.4-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday with the WIG 20 index up two percent to 1,538 points.
The remaining four stocks did not trade.
NFI units rose 1.1 percent to 140 zlotys in a 28-million-zloty turnover.
Seven National Investment Funds (NFIs) rose, three fell and five were flat in 2.4-million-zloty trade.
